latinIntro.en: Latin fatum, fate, is the direct source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fatum（命运）是直接词源。

items.meaning: a death caused by accident or violence
items.exampleCN: 这场撞车造成一人死亡。

items.example: Fatalities fell after the new rules.
items.exampleCN: 新规实施后死亡人数下降。

items.meaning: the belief that events are fixed
items.example: Fatalism can stop people from trying.
items.exampleCN: 宿命论会让人放弃尝试。

items.meaning: a person who believes in fate
items.example: The fatalist accepted the news calmly.
items.exampleCN: 宿命论者平静地接受了消息。

items.example: He has a fatalistic view of life.
items.exampleCN: 他对人生持宿命论观点。

items.example: The road was closed after a fatal accident.
items.exampleCN: 发生致命事故后道路封闭。

definition_en: the power believed to control events, what happens to someone or something, or death and ruin in literary use
core_image: 旧剧院门口的告示牌在风里摇晃，人们等待它最后的决定
scene: 这座老剧院最终会怎样，还没有人知道。The fate of the old theater is still unknown.
sceneCN: 这里 fate 是「结局；遭遇」（第 2 个义项）；句意：这座老剧院的命运仍不清楚。

senses.title: The power that decides events
senses.definition: the power believed to control what happens
senses.definitionCN: 被认为控制事件发生的力量
senses.example: He blamed fate for his bad luck.
senses.exampleCN: 他把坏运气归咎于命运。
senses.why: The core sense is an unseen controlling power.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是看不见的主宰力量。

senses.title: What happens to someone
senses.definition: the things that happen to a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 发生在某人或某物身上的事
senses.example: The fate of the old theater is still unknown.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老剧院的命运仍不清楚。
senses.why: The general power narrows to a particular outcome.
senses.whyCN: 笼统的力量缩小为具体结局。

senses.title: Death or destruction
senses.definition: death or ruin, especially in literary use
senses.definitionCN: 尤用于文学中的死亡或毁灭
senses.example: The sailors met their fate at sea.
senses.exampleCN: 水手们在海上遇难。
senses.why: The outcome sense becomes a euphemism for death.
senses.whyCN: 结局义成为死亡的委婉说法。

intro.en: Fate comes from Latin fatum, something spoken, and so a divine decree.
intro.cn: fate 源自拉丁语 fatum（说出的话），因此指神谕或天命。

items.en: Fari meant to speak.
items.cn: fari 意为说话。

items.en: Fatum meant a spoken decree or destiny.
items.cn: fatum 意为说出的神谕或命运。

items.en: Fate meant the power that decides events.
items.cn: fate 意为主宰事件的力量。

items.en: Fate also named what happens to a person.
items.cn: fate 也开始指发生在某人身上的事。

items.en: Fate can also mean death or ruin in literary use.
items.cn: 现代文学用法中 fate 还可指死亡或毁灭。

note.en: Fate is compared with similar short words and with words for destiny and doom.

the events that will happen to a person
a terrible future that cannot be avoided

normalIntro.en: Fate is the power behind events, and fatal describes its deadly result.

normal.en: Fate is the power behind events.
normal.cn: fate 是事件背后的力量。

normal.en: A twist of fate changes a life.
normal.cn: 命运的转折会改变人生。

normal.en: Fated means decided in advance.
normal.cn: fated 意为预先注定的。

normal.en: Fatal means leading to death.
normal.cn: fatal 意为导致死亡的。

normal.en: Fateful means having great consequences.
normal.cn: fateful 意为影响重大的。

abstract.en: Fate is the spoken decree behind events.
abstract.cn: 命运就是事件背后被说出的神谕。

abstract.en: Destiny and fate both name what seems beyond choice.
abstract.cn: destiny 与 fate 都指看似无法选择的事。

abstract.en: The word carries both comfort and fear.
abstract.cn: 这个词既带来安慰，也带来恐惧。

examples.en: The two friends shared the same fate.
examples.cn: 这两个朋友遭遇了同样的命运。

examples.en: A twist of fate brought them together.
examples.cn: 命运的转折让他们走到一起。

examples.en: She refused to accept her fate.
examples.cn: 她拒绝接受自己的命运。

dict_mnemonic.text: fate 源自拉丁语 fatum（说出的话、神谕），命运被看作被说出并决定的结局。

root: 源自拉丁语 fatum（说出的话、神谕、命运），来自 fari（说）。

sensesIntro.en: Fate means the power that controls events, what happens to someone, or death and ruin.
sensesIntro.cn: fate 意为主宰事件的力量、某人的结局，或死亡毁灭。

core.en: A power or outcome that seems beyond choice.
core.cn: 看似无法选择的支配力量或结局。

branches.en: An unseen power controlling events.
branches.cn: 控制事件的看不见的力量。

branches.en: The outcome waiting for a person or thing.
branches.cn: 等待某人或某物的结局。

branches.en: Death or ruin as a final outcome.
branches.cn: 作为最终结局的死亡或毁灭。

branches.en: The power and its result are two sides of one idea.
branches.cn: 力量与其结果是同一个概念的两面。

branches.en: A final outcome can mean death.
branches.cn: 最终结局可以意味着死亡。

intro.en: Fate forms adjectives and nouns about destiny and death.
intro.cn: fate 构成表示命运与死亡的形容词和名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin fatum and fari, to speak, are the sources.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fatum 与 fari（说）是词源。

items.exampleCN: 这个决定产生了重大后果。
那艘倒霉的船再也没有回来。
